state: Services/controllers implemented offline; publication blocked on unowned manifest; not roll-out ready.

common: assertLocalUsp requires the local operator; PDF input requires a registry_record target pin.
protectPdfPlanTx calls targetTx and scopedManifestTx: missing scope is NOT_FOUND; access/scope drift
is STALE_REVISION. Manifest selection must be exactly this one pin (PACKET_PLAN_SELECTION).
Captured target/member integrity failure is STALE_REVISION; wrong id/site/revision/kind is
PACKET_PLAN_TARGET. assessPdfPlanTx checks current committed target/history, identity and aliases.
Retired/cancelled targets are PACKET_PLAN_TARGET_ACCESS; changed context is STALE_REVISION.
sourceStatement: A space with sourceOnly has one entry under pack1-single-region-image/1; statementRecord validates
SourceStatedRecordSchema. Its bindingId is sourceStatementHandle(input.target), not a citation id.
The captured original revision/hash must match the statement: missing member is STALE_REVISION;
mismatched statement is PACKET_SOURCE_STATEMENT. Native preparation checks source/page/crop authority
and page bounds (PACKET_SOURCE_STATEMENT). No browser derivation is required after this read.
Important discrepancy: changing one character does NOT make create throw today. Preparation is skipped
and create returns blocked_required_context / committed_region_binding_unavailable. Confirmation
refuses PACKET_PLAN_BLOCKED. K12 tests and preserves that behavior rather than changing plan create.
storedBindings: Other targets load up to 25 RegistryDocumentCitationsSchema entries from body.documentCitations.
Region ids are persisted citation.id values from reviewed canonical commit: regionCitationId for PDF
page regions, imageRegionCitationId for original-image regions. Recipe/kind selects citation version.
Matching id must name the target, an earlier target revision and record_evidence purpose. A broken id
or uncommitted target/purpose is STALE_REVISION. Missing/non-region/wrong-version ids create blocked
entries with committed_region_binding_unavailable rather than causing create to throw.
Original access and validation can refuse with PACKET_PDF_SOURCE_ACCESS, REGISTRY_REGION_SOURCE_DENIED,
REGISTRY_REGION_COPY_UNSUPPORTED or STALE_REVISION. Image/mixed target mismatch is
PACKET_IMAGE_PDF_TARGET. Recipe bounds add PACKET_PDF_ORIGINAL_BYTES / PACKET_PDF_ORIGINAL_SCOPE.

order: assertLocalUsp; parse/fingerprint command; executed() reads the plan through readPacketPlan and
requires confirmation, execution and complete required context (CARD_EXECUTED_PLAN_REQUIRED).
prepare: protectedTx protects disclosure; authorizePlanTx checks access; planLinkageTx reads and
compares stored plan, confirmation, execution and, for PDF, packet linkage on the same SQL client.
requestReceiptTx takes a transaction advisory lock and reads a receipt. Replay validates card, actor,
link, protected authority/lifecycle and stored card linkage; it returns before expiry/projection.
No replay: expiry must be future and within 24 hours (CARD_EXPIRY).
Update: storedTx old card; actor; plan/version/expected manifest (CARD_REVISION_CONTEXT); link;
latest revision (STALE_REVISION); card transaction lock; lifecycle (CARD_REVISION_REVOKED); integer
bound (CARD_REVISION_BOUND). Then revision is old revision plus one; create starts at one.
projectCardFactsTx checks manifest and exact captured bodies/hashes, including source-stated ancestors
and citation, and projects facts. authorizePlanTx repeats; liveTx checks expiry on the database clock
(CARD_EXPIRED). Prepare commits; linkedPacket then reads protected private bytes and compares receipt.
Then id/resolver/profile selection, PDF render, object put (first persistent write). Publication
repeats prepare, compares projection/revision, reauthorizes and inserts card/receipt/outbox atomically.
previewRepeats: The same executed-view reader, protectedTx, expiry/revision checks, projectCardFactsTx, authorizePlanTx
and liveTx, in the same order, followed by the same linkedPacket reader outside the transaction.
No replay receipt: preview has no key and predicts a new command, not the replay of an old command.
Executed-view/linkage/packet reads require an executed plan and existing packet. Expiry, revision guard
and projection themselves do not inherently need execution, but this route deliberately requires it.

writes: Preparation and linked-packet helpers use SELECTs and transaction-scoped locks only: no receipt, lock
row or access-log insert. requestReceiptTx itself only SELECTs/locks; preview avoids it entirely.
Shared FOR SHARE helpers prohibit PostgreSQL READ ONLY transactions. Ordinary transactions, as in K7,
perform no DML; all row/advisory locks expire on commit/rollback. Tests assert the SQL write log is empty.
facts: generate data.facts is UspPropertyCardSchema.facts, an ordered array of UspPropertyCardFactSchema
(PropertyCardFact). Both renderers iterate exactly those labels/values, prefixing missing states.
PDF also has title/private-revision/snapshot header, disclaimer, footer card/plan/packet ids, counts,
capture time, expiry, packet hash, fixed-snapshot/access notices, QR link and private-access captions.
Preview facts are not a complete PDF transcript. Future card-id/QR/footer lines and font/layout checks
are not previewed, and no id is invented. Projection/rendering files were not edited.

entries.order: The one source-statement entry, in record order.
entries.handle: The same sourceStatementHandle call that plan create checks; no second hash derivation.
entries.qualification: Recorded-entry eligibility only. Plan create still validates native page/crop bounds.

preview.receiptBehavior: Generate still checks replay first; preview never reads or stores a receipt.
description: The rows a card made now from this executed plan would print.
A preview is not a card: nothing is stored and it has no id.
